zero.name: Zero
zero.sourceQuote: Zero will be its own mind

facets.mind: Represent zero and reason about what a cleared state means in its own context.
facets.eyes: Inspect the source of the starting state and the receipt for what was cleared.
facets.soul: Zero’s distinct identity in Nathan Tabor’s sovereign-box design.
facets.spirit: Clear explicitly through 1 − 1 = 0 and keep the relevant source history.
facets.shadow: Flag an apparent absence when the source is missing, hidden, or unverified.

one.name: One
one.sourceQuote: one will be its own mind

facets.mind: Represent one independent unit and reason about what it contributes.
facets.eyes: Inspect the original unit and the provenance of each relationship.
facets.soul: One’s distinct identity in Nathan Tabor’s sovereign-box design.
facets.spirit: Build through 1 + 1 = 2 and record the relationship between the units.
facets.shadow: Flag identity mergers, duplicate counts, and claims that lack a source.
